title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned candidate 6 — The Programme. Keep it, take the pick or a challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: The Programme
options.thesis: Ensar's portfolio built as a football programme — the résumé as a match document, the developer-climber duality printed on the cover like a squad card.
options.viewport: Full-height forest green opening field. Programme header in tracked small caps: 'ENSAR INCE · ISSUE 01 · SOFTWARE DEVELOPER'. Name at 12vw Barlow Condensed 900. Photo right with jersey-number overlay. Two actions bottom-left.
options.risk: Reads as costume when the information density is not genuine — stat tables must contain real content, or the form collapses into decoration.

raised.raise: Each section descends into progressively more intimate territory — programme cover to match report to squad sheet to player notes.
One saturated colour field does structural work per major section boundary, not scattered accent touches.
One near-black section breaks the density with a single white fact at stage-filling scale.
One moment of radical negative space: one large fact, the rest of the page empty.

options.label: The Guidebook
options.lineage: Alpine climbing guidebooks — Panico Verlag, Rockfax, DAV guides
options.thesis: The portfolio as a technical route guide — each project a graded climb, the bio a crag description, the skills page a topo diagram.
options.viewport: Clean paper ground. Left: large crag photo of Ensar with a route-line drawn over it, grade and name annotated. Right: technical brief — grade, style, location, first-ascent note, short description.
options.risk: The most familiar form when the subject is a climber — strong association risk. Also where most runs on this brief land.

options.label: Versailles Garden
options.lineage: Gardens of Versailles — axial vistas, embroidered parterres, bosquets
options.viewport: Palace-axis hero opening onto parterre sections below; navigation descends through increasingly private garden chambers.
options.case: Recruiters do not identify with Versailles; the mechanism (persistence, system-reading) does not map to formal French gardens.
options.kept: Spatial reveal and progressive depth — each scroll unveils a more private space.
options.risk: Precious and abstract for a 30-second decision.

options.label: Silk Canopy
options.lineage: Translucent silk banners crossing a sunlit courtyard — computational colour chords
options.viewport: Horizontal translucent colour bands crossing a white field; overlap zones create deeper chord states as bands coincide.
options.case: The colour-chord metaphor requires explanation before it reads; product clarity is low for a 30-second recruiter scan.
options.kept: Bold colour commitment as structure — whole regions owned by colour, not scattered accent touches.
options.risk: Abstract; the duality needs translation before it lands.

options.label: The Darkroom
options.lineage: Photo darkroom — safelight, developing trays, silver gelatin prints
options.viewport: Near-black ground. Warm safelight glow at the horizon. White typography emerging from dark like a developing print.
options.case: The darkroom metaphor requires explanation; audience identification is low outside photography circles.
options.kept: Total tonal control and dark-to-light reveals — the patience of development.
options.risk: Reads obscure and niche for a recruiter decision.

options.label: Civic Prospectus
options.viewport: Near-empty bone white. One dramatic teal-to-violet ribbon across the right bleed. Single violet CTA. Dark bench object sits in the light.
options.case: The climbing-developer identity disappears into generic SaaS polish; loses on both audience identification and product clarity.
options.kept: Radical spatial restraint — almost everything drops away and one element owns the stage.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from a hundred polished tech portfolios.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer portfolio the category always ships — hero name, project grid, skills list — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Large name hero, CTA pair, scrolling project cards below. Familiar and effective.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
